verdict.rationale: The AWS CLI is built to control services from the terminal and automate them through scripts, with full console-equivalent functionality. GitHub Actions and other CI systems can authenticate through OIDC federation and assumed roles that issue temporary credentials, with no long-term keys. CloudFormation and CDK provide declarative, code-driven provisioning that suits unattended pipelines. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI/headless usage, and explicit documentation of non-interactive output and CI pipeline setup.
